_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE deltoid volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_deltoid_from_cryo.py: the male's superficial-proximity rule applied to her registered cryosection photographs, anchored on her TotalSegmentator humerus and scapula labels), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Rule-based: muscle-class voxels within 55 mm of the proximal humerus, within 40 mm of the skin, lateral to the scapula's lateral edge, not already a trunk-muscle label; deep and posterior boundaries are approximate; badge it.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 labels as anchors.
